import statistics

# Treasury Tax and Loan Account Monthly Average Balance (1961) in millions
treasury = [3414, 3812, 3705, 2171, 3765, 3572, 3739, 4581, 4277, 5924, 4873, 3869]

# U.S. Unemployment Rate (1961) in percent
unemployment = [6.6, 6.9, 6.9, 7.0, 7.1, 6.9, 7.0, 6.6, 6.7, 6.5, 6.1, 6.0]

# Calculate Pearson correlation coefficient
n = len(treasury)
mean_t = sum(treasury) / n
mean_u = sum(unemployment) / n

numerator = sum((t - mean_t) * (u - mean_u) for t, u in zip(treasury, unemployment))
denominator_t = sum((t - mean_t) ** 2 for t in treasury) ** 0.5
denominator_u = sum((u - mean_u) ** 2 for u in unemployment) ** 0.5

r = numerator / (denominator_t * denominator_u)

print(f"Treasury balances: {treasury}")
print(f"Unemployment rates: {unemployment}")
print(f"Mean treasury: {mean_t}")
print(f"Mean unemployment: {mean_u}")
print(f"Pearson correlation: {r}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimals: {round(r, 2)}")
EOF
